U_0x009436.en: A captured Lion, the <DC>'s mass-production <Armored Module>, with upgraded weapons and armor. Spare <Personal Trooper> parts from the Huckebein, Gespenst and Alt Eisen are used; its arms are <Personal Trooper> parts, and folding leg blades let it handle the close combat the Lion was poor at. A stopgap between <Personal Trooper> and <Armored Module>, but its potential is high.

U_0x009718.en: Under Dr. Marion Radom's plan, Tasuku Shinguji upgraded the Guarlion Custom flown by his lover, Leona Garstein. The latest <Personal Trooper> tech and a <Tesla Drive> boost mobility and firepower, plus the <T-LINK System>. As on the Guarlion, shoulder force-field inductors fix induction-heated metal particles ahead of it, wrapped and extended by a telekinetic field to strike foes.

U_0x009CE6.en: An <Armored Module> for space flight and vacuum work, from interstellar program <Project TD>. Newest of the Series 77, based on the earlier Asterion AX. Twin flank-mounted <Tesla Drives> give it mobility no other <Armored Module> can match. It shifts between the flight-use Cruise Figure (CF) and work-use Doll Figure (DF). Against hostile deep-space life it mounts the gravity-controlled cannon 'G Accel Driver' and 'CTM' tactical missiles.

U_0x00A05A.en: A high-mobility <Armored Module> from interstellar flight program <Project TD>. Newest of Series 77, based on the Calion. Two compact <Tesla Drives> give speed and agility beyond its sister, the Altairlion.

U_0x00A1F1.en: Combined form of the Altairlion and Vegalion, the newest <Project TD> Series 77 units. Its mobility and agility top every <Armored Module>, with immense firepower.

U_0x00ACDE.en: A high-mobility <Armored Module> by <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>, designed from <Project TD> Calion and Vegalion data. It rivals the Vegalion, and the flexible weapon operators on its wings wield <Armored Module> and <Personal Trooper> firearms. It also has a weapon bay of MTD missiles and a folding TDA nose.

U_0x00B141.en: ZAn <Armored Module> based on a Galerion prototype, customized for the <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet its <Tesla Drive> and thrusters outdo the Asterion AX.

U_0x00B2C3.en: An <Armored Module> based on a Galerion (Guarlion successor) prototype, tuned for the <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet its <Tesla Drive> and back thrusters outdo the Asterion AX in mobility. An EW model with EA (attack), EP (defense), and ES (support) functions.
